strategy.summary: Reproduce scipy.linalg.schur sort-callable bug (gh-13137, PR 21429) on buggy commit e2ce1a57639d: for real dtype with output='real' (DGEES/SGEES path), complex eigenvalues reach the sort callable as two real arguments, so the 'iuc'/'ouc' string sorts count wrong. Run the two new tests test_gh_13137_sort_str and test_gh_13137_sort_custom in scipy/linalg/tests/test_decomp.py; they must fail on the buggy build and pass on the fixed one.

environment.python_version: 3.10-3.12 (era-inferred, not stated by evidence; pick 3.11 if unsure)
pip_packages: numpy<2.2 (era ceiling 2.1, numerically relevant, inferred from PR date, not a documented constraint)
system_packages: gfortran (required for the Fortran LAPACK/f2py wrappers used by schur)
a C/C++ compiler toolchain (gcc or clang)
BLAS/LAPACK: use the default scipy-bundled OpenBLAS (scipy-openblas); LAPACK constraint is unbounded in the evidence, so this choice is made here and not documented
build_commands: git clone https://github.com/scipy/scipy && cd scipy && git checkout e2ce1a57639d && git submodule update --init
pinned_because: numpy<2.2: era ceiling 2.1 at PR date 2024-08-26 (era-inferred, numerically relevant)
LAPACK version: no documented constraint and no era table entry; default bundled OpenBLAS LAPACK chosen and stated here, not relied on as documented
Fortran/f2py callback signature for DGEES/SGEES sort is the mechanism being tested, so a source build from the buggy commit is required rather than a wheel

strategy.reproducing_test: scipy/linalg/tests/test_decomp.py::TestSchur::test_gh_13137_sort_str (parametrized sort in iuc/ouc, output in real/complex, dtype in float32/float64/complex64/complex128) and test_gh_13137_sort_custom (output x dtype)
strategy.success_criterion: On buggy e2ce1a57639d: test_gh_13137_sort_str fails for output='real' with float32/float64 (callable receives split real/imag args, so the sdim count for the matrix [[0.1,-2],[2,0.1]] is wrong or the call raises), and test_gh_13137_sort_custom fails on the all_real cases. On the fixed revision: all gh_13137 parametrizations pass, with sdim==0 for 'iuc' and sdim==2 for 'ouc' on the real-output cases and the complex-argument callable receiving one complex value.
strategy.numerical_probe: schur(np.asarray([[0.1,-2],[2,0.1]]).astype(dtype), sort=sort, output=output)[-1] for dtype in float32/float64 with output='real' and sort in iuc/ouc; compare sdim to 0 (iuc) or 2 (ouc)

input_output_examples.buggy_output: not stated in evidence; expected to be a wrong sdim or a call error because the one-argument string callable receives two real args

risks: The bug only manifests on the real-dtype, output='real' path (DGEES/SGEES two-real-argument callback). Complex dtypes or output='complex' pass on buggy code, so a failing run must be confirmed on the float parametrizations specifically.

LAPACK version is unbounded in the evidence; if the bundled OpenBLAS differs from the one used at the time, the eigenvalue pair ordering could change. The counts for this matrix are order-invariant, so the expected outcome should be unaffected, but this is an assumption.
NumPy >=2.2 may break the f2py callback or the build at this commit; keep numpy<2.2 as era-inferred.
Building scipy from source is slow and needs gfortran and a matching build backend; if the build environment is missing these, the test cannot run on any platform.

The buggy-revision failure mode for the custom test is not fully specified in the evidence (the test comment says no error is raised when the callable accepts one argument), so the custom test may pass on buggy code for some parametrizations; the sort_str test is the decisive transition.
No sanitizer or unusual architecture is implied by the evidence; a default x86_64 Linux build should suffice, but this is not verified.

oracle.reference_source: documented sort definitions in the task context: 'iuc' is abs(eigenvalue)<=1.0 and 'ouc' is abs(eigenvalue)>1.0; integer sdim counts from the test assertion
oracle.why: The output is an integer count of eigenvalues inside or outside the unit circle, so exact equality is the criterion

strategy.fails_on_buggy: On buggy e2ce1a57639d, for output='real' with float32/float64, schur calls the sort callable with separate real and imaginary arguments. The string sort expects one complex argument, so sdim disagrees with the expected 0 (iuc) or 2 (ouc), or a call error is raised; the assert sdim == ... fails or the call raises.
strategy.passes_on_fixed: On the fixed revision, the real-output float cases pass with sdim==0 for iuc and sdim==2 for ouc; complex and complex-output cases continue to pass; test_gh_13137_sort_custom passes for all parametrizations.
